headline: US Ports and Energy Export Terminals Target of Cyberattack Surge
summary: U.S. port facilities, crude export hubs, and maritime logistics firms face an increasing wave of digital intrusion attempts, with major crude terminals recording thousands of daily attacks.
why: Cyber threats against critical energy infrastructure and seaport logistical hubs risk disrupting global oil supply chains and physical ocean freight traffic.

impacts.name: WTI Crude
impacts.why: Cyberattack risks against major US crude export hubs create energy supply security premiums.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reports of persistent cyberattacks on U.S. crude export terminals increased operational disruption concerns in oil markets.
